correctness.rationale: Summing each directed edge variable including loops in eight-weight two-predicate Markov logic network yields exact P(M_n=m) proportional to binom(n,m)c11^(m^2)c00^((n-m)^2)(c10*c01)^(m(n-m)). On boundary c10*c01=c00^2 and c11<c00 this becomes binom(n,m)exp(-a m^2), a>0. The Lambert saddle x=W(2an)/(2a) solves log(n/x)=2ax; Stirling local expansion at floor(x)+j yields exp(-a(j-theta)^2) with uniformly summable Gaussian tails from decreasing adjacent exact ratios, proving total-variation phase approximations and theta prefactor. Full phase subsequences follow x_{n+1}-x_n->0. Independently directly computed binomial distributions for n=200,1000,10000,100000 at a=.4,log2,1.5, checking decreasing TV and partition relative error, plus very large n x~95 asymptotic convergence; finite checks corroborate not prove limits. Colour reversal gives the dual boundary; claims do not extend off the exact critical surfaces.
